history: First coffee farm at Doondu, Kiambu, and three more Kiambu farms bought in 1959.
Stake in Kipkebe Limited taken in the tea sub-sector west of the Rift Valley, raised to 100 per cent in 1965.
Macadamia factory commissioned in March 2019, cracking capacity 4 million kg of nuts in shell a year.
notes: The issuer's website states 775 ha of coffee in one place and 710 ha in another; the audited report's 708 ha of mature bushes is the figure used here.
Pins show where the land is, not its surveyed outline. A hectareage is a total for the crop, not an area for the individual site named against it.
